propositions: make amend-msg silently drops Signed-off-by trailers from HEAD while preserving Change-Id, using the same wholesale message replacement mechanism it was designed to prevent for Change-Id

compose_message() extracts and re-attaches only Change-Id; all other trailers come from the replacement FILE, so Signed-off-by present on HEAD but absent from the author's new message is lost when git commit --amend --file replaces the message
the wrapper must preserve Signed-off-by from HEAD when the new message file omits it, applying the same carry-forward logic already used for Change-Id
the fix must not duplicate Signed-off-by if the author's message file already includes one, and must preserve multiple distinct sign-offs from HEAD in order
CI does not enforce Signed-off-by presence on commits, so the loss is silent and undetected until later or never
